successors.name: Dawenkou culture
successors.text: "central and southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu provinces" (Beixin type site at Tengzhou)

ledger.x: 5300 BCE: the Beixin culture appears in central and southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu: "The Beixin culture (5300-4100 BC)", successor of the Houli, which ended in 5500 on its own page.
4100 BCE: the Beixin gives way to the Dawenkou culture: the page calls the Beixin the precursor of the Dawenkou, dated "(4100-2600 BC)", and the Dawenkou page says it "descends from the Beixin".

certainty.note: No border is recorded; known from fifty sites.
